notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Added easier sticks control mode. Sticks mode can be changed in game settings in main menu.
More clear instructions in some quests.
Game stability improved.

notes.title: TINY ISLAND IS IN THE FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hey y'all, TINY ISLAND is finally out!
 
Flow into the meditative vibe, master the chopsticks, and enjoy the picturesque views.
And all that with a hugely reduced price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/a5edcc8a0c44e6f0ecfee19c57a85c372f915fd6.gif

See you on TINY ISLAND

notes.title: Tiny Island is Going Full Release
notes.notes:
Huge news everyone! 

Tiny Island is going full release on the 24th of May! The full version will include the complete island story, some improved mechanics, and new interactions! 

The other big thing is that the game will be lowered in price and will cost $4,99 starting the 24th of May!

[previewyoutube=ctqg7DnIV28;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, due to your feedback, we decided to remove the free mode from the game as it is not as amusing as we wanted it to be. 

Furthermore, we wish to thank everyone who played the game during the Early Access and shared their thoughts with us – that was really helpful and inspiring! 

And now Jump into the fluffy adventure and see you on Tiny Island!

notes.title: THE NEW UPDATE IS LIVE
notes.notes:
Hey, y'all! 

The Update is live, and you can check it out right away. 

Meet the New tutorial island with new quests and activities.
Also, the game got a bunch of minor improvements and fixes!

And, here comes not so tiny discount - 66% off the price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/1cc0afdaf67692d4a638da032e836a919dd0caa6.gif

And don't forget to leave tiny feedback at our communities on Steam, Discord, and Twitter^^

notes.title: THE UPDATE DELAY
notes.notes:
Hey, y'all! 

We decided to move our new update release for one week in an effort to deliver the best experience to the  players

notes.title: NEW UPDATE

Hey, y'all!

The big thing about it is the brand-new tutorial; we hope you love it. Also, there will be a bunch of tiny improvements and fixes. So don’t miss it ^^

notes.title: TINY ISLAND'S DATE OF EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

Thanks a lot for all your patience and support! And now we are ready to announce:

TINY ISLAND WILL BE AVAILABLE ON STEAM EARLY ACCESS ON THE 9TH OF DECEMBER 2022!

You’ll be able to play it in story mode, and also there’re two islands to explore in free mode! 

Feel free to share your thought at the Steam Community hub, on Discord or you can fill out our tiny survey on Tiny Island’s website!
